subject: Issue #20 — architecture and existing PR reconciliation

findings.statement: Issue #20 addresses duplicated development and uncertain ownership before MCP implementation; acceptance requires a file-level reuse matrix.
Existing open PRs #2, #8, #9, #13, #14, #15, #42, #43 and #44 have distinct changed paths as observed, while logical dependency and reuse questions remain.
Reducing rework is a reasonable intended value, but no cycle-time, baseline effort or change failure metric has been measured.

missingEvidence: Baseline duplicate-work count and measurable time-saved criterion
Explicit consumer/owner sign-off for canonical source hierarchy
Dependency-level interface and data-contract compatibility review
recommendations: Set success criterion: 100% open portfolio PRs mapped to owner/module, no duplicate implementation admitted, all UNKNOWNs recorded.
Approve smallest next deliverable as evidence-only PR reuse matrix and source-of-truth ADR.
Do not mark issue #20 complete until code/interface review and checks cover the required negative provenance tests.
